highlights.reason_zh: 价格不变但速度和 token 用量可能重算主力模型成本，迁移前先验证 effort 与 thinking。
highlights.reason_en: Unchanged token pricing may still reset workhorse-model economics; validate effort and thinking migration.

highlights.reason_zh: 开放权重让表格冷启动变成一次前向计算，适合与树模型做留出集对照。
highlights.reason_en: Open weights turn tabular cold starts into one forward pass; compare against tree baselines.

highlights.reason_zh: OAuth issuer 校验和自动翻页会改变安全边界与运行成本，升级前要回归。
highlights.reason_en: OAuth issuer validation and auto-pagination change security and runtime behavior; regression-test the upgrade.

highlights.reason_zh: 结构化证据契约几乎消除工具失败后的错误报喜，适合小范围试验。
highlights.reason_en: A structured evidence contract nearly eliminates false success after tool failure and is cheap to trial.

highlights.reason_zh: 运行中转向与沙箱拒绝规则同时进入稳定版，值得升级前回归。
highlights.reason_en: In-flight steering and preserved sandbox denials land together in stable; regression-test before rollout.

coverage_zh: 检查 11 个固定公开入口并补充一手来源检索；新增 8 个事件，更新 Codex、Qwen Code 与 Claude Code 三个既有事件，完成 5 项到期复核。Codex alpha、Gemini CLI nightly、Ollama prerelease 与低信号候选均已过滤。
coverage_en: Checked 11 fixed public entry points plus primary-source discovery: eight new events, updates to Codex, Qwen Code and Claude Code, and five completed due reviews. Codex alphas, a Gemini CLI nightly, the Ollama prerelease and lower-signal candidates were filtered.
